title: Ozeri Deluxe Milk Frother and Whisk in Stainless Steel with Stand and 4-Frothing Attachments
features: Petite yet powerful, whips up foam in as little as 10 secs. Ideal for steam-free cappuccinos, lattes, espressos, hot chocolates, shakes and frappes.
Powerful motor spins at over 15,000 RPMs and activates instantly with results in 10 to 20 seconds.
Foams all kinds of milk (whole/regular/skim, soy, almond and coconut milk) alike for fluffy hot cafe lattes or cold chocolate malts in seconds.
Includes an egg beater to whisk eggs, soups, dressings, sauces and other non-solid food items, and a propeller-shaped attachment for mixing cocktails.
Ships with 4 frothing attachments - 2 Milk Frothing Whisks, 1 Egg Beater, 1 Cocktail Mixer, an elegant stand and 2 AA batteries.
